evidence_boundary: Known-covariance geometry, scientific calibration and computational scalability are separate evidence. The original n=800 matched study has six independent panels per cell. The 20K workload has one phenotype per scenario and repeated timings, not independent calibration replication. HE and official LDAK fit different covariance workflows; reported h2 values are not interchangeable. HAPNEST simulation-only reaches 100K samples at 12K variants; GWAS reaches 50K samples at 20K variants. Synthetic references do not validate empirical human diversity or upstream Julia equivalence. Research directions remain proposals. The 2.0.0.dev5 comparison has two repetitions per source on simulated panels under unrelated host load; the Lanczos study tests the trace estimator on six panels with one phenotype each. Benchmark reruns reuse official outputs on identical inputs; their cross-program timings span two days. The genotype-streaming archive has two repetitions per source on synthetic panels at 10,000 and 20,000 samples on an idle host. The e4089d8 reruns repeat only the mixmogam half; one same-day check of two workloads separates code from host conditions.

benchmark_reruns.policy: mixmogam methods rerun with 2.0.0.dev6 on the archived inputs (genotypes verified against export hashes), each timed fit waiting for a one-minute load average below 5 (--max-load 5); official LDAK-KVIK outputs, logs and timings reused from the original runs. The 20K workload ran with the default cross-fitted scores and again with in-sample scores (--loco-folds 1).
benchmark_reruns.timing_limitation: Reruns ran on 6 October; exact LOCO and BOLT-inf, whose results did not change, took 1.07-1.16x as long as in the e4089d8 reruns of 5 October. Alternating the versions on one n=800 case on one host, dev6 took 1.07x (exact LOCO) and 1.03x (HRATT) as long. A first pass without the load gate (loads 6-15) gave identical results and was discarded. At 20K, in-sample fits took 1.04-1.09x the e4089d8 times; cross-fitting cost 1.28-1.38x (one thread) and 1.53-1.59x (four), because its five fold fits stayed below _vb._GEMM_MIN_COLUMNS = 6 (removed since; crossfit_gemm_evidence).

HE-versus-REML peaks 1.08/1.02 GiB (HE) and 1.68/1.54 GiB (REML). 20K four-worker HE 1.40/1.40 GiB cross-fitted, two-bit 0.77/0.79 GiB.
